page.overview:
Who is S.I.L.A.H.A.?

is an Aeormaton sorcerer/warlock played by Abubakar Salim in Downfall. He is a mortal avatar of the god Corellon, the Arch Heart.

SILAHA is beautiful, with a dark frame that is difficult to see where it begins and ends, like a painting sprinkled with golden freckles that occasionally move, and orange eyes that occasionally glow green. He holds himself regally, and moves more fluidly when he is among friends..}}

As the Chosen One, the golden freckles cover his whole body, and his eyes turn green.

He is a charismatic and socially savvy individual, well respected. He is vain, hedonistic, and enjoys attention and beauty in every form, but deep down he's sorrowful because of the knowledge that his godly self, the Arch Heart, is directly responsible for Aeor being so advanced and dangerous, causing the Aeormaton to even contemplate the possibility of giving up existence.
